summary: Count a fresh agents list (st agents ls and tree) under its own person-read-fresh target instead of under none

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change; the windows are process memory only.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: GET /v1/client/request-latency paths and st doctor change for fresh=true agents reads only: they move from 'GET /v1/client/agents (long poll)' to 'GET /v1/client/agents (fresh)' and a new person-read-fresh target (p99 300 ms) with its own slo/person-read-fresh doctor line, a miss being info. The 100 ms person-read target and every other target are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Normal restart on deploy; the windows start empty after each restart.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build drops only the in-memory windows and the new target.
